questions.prompt: Why do security analysts closely monitor writes to `HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run`?

options.a: It is a classic autostart persistence location (T1547.001) — executable values set here run automatically at logon/boot
options.b: It controls screen resolution and display drivers
options.c: It stores network firewall port filter rules

questions.prompt: Which two PowerShell virtual PSDrives expose the Windows registry?
What happens when `Get-ItemProperty HKLM:\...` is executed on pwsh 7 on Linux?

options.a: It fails with an error because registry PSDrives exist only on Windows platforms
options.b: It reads Linux system configuration from /etc/registry
options.c: It mounts a remote Windows server registry automatically
